title: Big Number support

complexity.rationale: The s1 implementation fully satisfies the original request, so no s1 work remains. The open item is a product decision, not a research/implementation task by itself: whether S2 supports BigNumber at all. Scored 3 (not 1) because that decision, once made 'yes', unlocks real implementation work with only a types stub to build from (packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/types/marks/bigNumberSpec.types.ts has no matching builder or component yet) — i.e. a genuine open question plus non-trivial follow-on work if it resolves to 'build it'.

summary: This 2024 request asked for a BigNumber chart type showing a metric value, metric label, and an optional visual element. That capability is fully implemented in s1: packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/rc/components/BigNumber/BigNumber.tsx, exported from the package's `/rc` entry point, with `dataKey`/`label`/`method`/`numberFormat`/`numberType`/`orientation` props, an optional `icon` element, and an optional sparkline (`<Line>` child) — matching or exceeding the original request. This issue remains relevant, though, because S2 support is still an open product decision: only a types stub (`BigNumberOptions`) exists in vega-spec-builder-s2, with no builder or component — whether S2 will support BigNumber at all still needs to be decided.
requirements: s1: already fully satisfied — see implementationPlan for file:line evidence.

s2: pending a product decision on whether BigNumber will be supported in S2 at all; if yes, requirements should mirror the s1 API (dataKey, label, method, numberFormat, numberType, orientation, optional icon, optional sparkline) unless S2 design calls for changes.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Already supported: BigNumberInternal renders label+value with no icon/lineProps branch when neither is supplied (BigNumber.tsx lines 102-111).

edgeCases.case: Metric value with optional visual element (s1)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Already supported via `icon` (IconElement prop) and/or sparkline (`<Line>` child), per BigNumber.tsx lines 73-112 and packages/docs/docs/api/visualizations/BigNumber.md.

crossCutting.notes: s1 has a complete BigNumber implementation; s2 has only a types stub (BigNumberOptions in vega-spec-builder-s2/src/types/marks/bigNumberSpec.types.ts) with no spec builder or React component. Whether s2 gets a matching implementation depends on the pending product decision on S2 BigNumber support, not on a code gap alone.

implementationPlan.change: No change — this is the existing BigNumber/BigNumberInternal implementation satisfying the original request (metric value, metric label, optional icon and/or sparkline).
No change — BigNumberOptions already defines dataKey, label, orientation, numberFormat, numberType, method, and lines (sparkline children).
No change — BigNumberProps already exposes the icon element and Line children on top of BigNumberOptions.
No change — the component is already documented with examples for basic, icon, sparkline, icon+sparkline, and currency-format variants.

Types-only stub exists (orientation, label, dataKey, numberFormat, numberType, method, lines) but has no matching spec builder or component. Pending: product decision on whether S2 will support BigNumber at all.

openQuestions: Will S2 support BigNumber at all? This is a pending product decision, not a technical blocker — the s1 implementation is a ready-made reference if the answer is yes.
